slides.headline: See Beyond The Stars
slides.description: Elegant opening frame with a refined Bangkok dining backdrop, a central contrast between aggregate star ratings and aspect-level insight, and a restrained data motif.
slides.narration: Bangkok’s finest restaurants already have the answers in their reviews. We reveal the patterns hidden beyond the stars.

slides.headline: Every Voice, Precisely Read
slides.description: Clean four-stage pipeline diagram showing collection, language-aware preparation, AI aspect analysis, and structured insight across 30–50 restaurants.
bullets: Collect reviews across Bangkok’s fine dining scene
Decode sentiment across twelve guest experience aspects
Turn unstructured feedback into comparable signals
slides.narration: Our AI research pipeline gathers, cleans, and interprets thousands of multilingual reviews across the experiences that matter most.

slides.headline: Benchmark What Guests Feel
slides.description: Premium analytics dashboard composition featuring an AI Restaurant Score, competitive radar chart, and positioning map contrasting operational excellence with guest experience.
bullets: Rank performance beyond simple star averages
Compare food, service, atmosphere, and value
See competitive position at a glance
slides.narration: The result is a more meaningful benchmark: a restaurant score built from what guests actually praise, question, and remember.

slides.headline: Find The Moment That Matters
slides.description: Horizontal customer journey map from reservation through payment, with sentiment clusters, recurring themes, and highlighted friction points along the journey.
bullets: Trace sentiment from reservation to payment
Spot changes across time and experience
slides.narration: We map the complete guest journey, showing exactly where sentiment strengthens, breaks down, or changes over time.

slides.headline: From Insight To Action
slides.description: One-page executive benchmark report shown as a polished editorial dashboard, combining strengths, weaknesses, quick wins, market position, and prioritized recommendations.
bullets: Identify one defining strength and weakness
Convert evidence into a sharper guest experience
slides.narration: Each restaurant receives a focused action plan: its position, its priorities, and the clearest opportunities to improve what guests value most.
